message.projecthero.gyro.title: THE SPIN
message.projecthero.gyro.subtitle: The Zeppeli family's secret is yours
message.projecthero.gyro.acquired_hint: R throws a Steel Ball. Hold Shift+G and let go as the gold rectangle lines up for a Perfect Spin. Shift+X whistles for your horse, Valkyrie. Open the Guidebook (Other Heroes) for every move.
message.projecthero.gyro.disguised: Face Spin: you're disguised for 20 seconds
message.projecthero.gyro.breaker_failed: Not a Perfect Spin: Ball Breaker won't come out
message.projecthero.gyro.valkyrie_dead: Valkyrie fell. She can come again in %ss
message.projecthero.gyro.valkyrie_fell: Valkyrie has fallen. Whistle again in 60 seconds
hud.projecthero.gyro.title: Gyro Zeppeli
hud.projecthero.gyro.golden_hint: Let go when the rectangles line up
hud.projecthero.gyro.breaker_hint: Ball Breaker needs a Perfect Spin
projecthero.gyro.ability.steel_ball.desc: Throw one ball up to 30 blocks. It hits the first creature for 10 damage and spins its body for 3 seconds: it staggers about and can't aim. The ball always flies back to your hand. 15 Spin.
projecthero.gyro.ability.twin_balls.desc: Throw both balls at once. They curve in from either side onto where you aim, 10 damage each, and both come back. 30 Spin.
projecthero.gyro.ability.spin_touch.desc: Press the spinning ball against the creature in front of you (4 blocks): 6 damage and its joints lock, so it can't move for 2 seconds. A player drops what's in their main hand. 20 Spin.
projecthero.gyro.ability.golden_spin.des: Hold to charge. A gold rectangle shrinks onto your crosshair; let go as it lines up with the frame for a Perfect Spin. The ball tears through blocks and creatures in a 40-block line: 35 damage, or 70 that ignores armour on a Perfect Spin. Twice as quick to line up on a horse. 50 Spin, 12 s cooldown.
projecthero.gyro.ability.scan.desc: Set a ball spinning on the ground. For 8 seconds every creature and player within 40 blocks glows gold through walls, for you alone. 15 Spin.
projecthero.gyro.ability.ball_breaker.de: Hold to charge like the Golden Spin. Only a Perfect Spin works: a pale armoured figure bursts out of the ball and strikes the creature you aim at (30 blocks) for 60 damage through armour, then ages it: Weakness II, Slowness III and Wither for 10 seconds. A release that isn't Perfect fails and costs 20 Spin. 100 Spin, 3 min cooldown.
projecthero.gyro.ability.spin_leap.desc: Spin your leg muscles and leap about 12 blocks forward and 5 up. No fall damage when you land. On a horse, the horse leaps. 10 Spin.
projecthero.gyro.ability.valkyrie.desc: Whistle for your horse Valkyrie: she gallops to you and you mount. She's tamed, saddled, armoured, very fast and has 40 health. If she dies you must wait 60 seconds before a whistle brings her back.
projecthero.gyro.ability.spin_quake.desc: Hammer the ball into the ground: 14 damage to everything within 6 blocks, knocked off their feet and slowed for 2 seconds. 25 Spin.
projecthero.gyro.ability.spin_shield.des: Both balls orbit you for 4 seconds. They knock arrows, bullets and fireballs away and hit anything that comes close for 4 damage. 30 Spin.
projecthero.gyro.ability.healing_spin.de: Heal 6 hearts over 3 seconds and clear poison and slowness. Aim at a squadmate (16 blocks) to heal them instead. 25 Spin, 15 s cooldown.
projecthero.gyro.ability.face_spin.desc: Spin your face into a disguise for 20 seconds: your name tag is hidden and mobs leave you alone, except the ones that see you attack. 20 Spin.
projecthero.guide.gyro.body: The Zeppeli family's Spin, worked through two steel balls. Every move spins something: a creature's body, the ground, your own legs, even your face.
projecthero.guide.gyro.getting.body: Find the Zeppeli Steel Balls, a rare find in desert pyramid chests and trail ruins (brush the suspicious gravel). Right-click them to learn the Spin. It replaces your Primary power. Random serums never give it.
projecthero.guide.gyro.traits.body: While you have the Spin: 8 extra hearts, 15% faster movement, +4 melee damage and 15% less damage from every hit.
projecthero.guide.gyro.spin.body: Your Spin bar holds 100 and pays for your moves. It refills at 4 a second.
projecthero.guide.gyro.balls.body: You carry two balls, in your hand or on your belt. A thrown ball always flies back to you. While a ball is out, the moves that need it are greyed out on the HUD until it returns.
projecthero.guide.gyro.golden.body: Holding Golden Spin or Ball Breaker shrinks a gold rectangle onto your crosshair. Let go while it lines up with the frame (it flashes white) for a Perfect Spin: double damage that ignores armour. Ball Breaker only works on a Perfect Spin.
projecthero.guide.gyro.riding.body: On a horse every Spin move hits 30% harder and the Golden Rectangle lines up twice as fast.
projecthero.guide.gyro.valkyrie.body: Shift+X whistles for Valkyrie, your own horse. She comes galloping and you mount. If she dies, she can come back after 60 seconds.
projecthero.guide.gyro.commands.body: Operators: /projecthero power tune gyro spin <0-100>, cooldowns.
